rfm_rules.recency: Days since last positive merchandise invoice, as of the day after the source end date.
rfm_rules.frequency: Distinct positive merchandise invoices across the entire source period.
rfm_rules.monetary: Gross positive merchandise sales in GBP, before credits; no profit or lifetime value claim.
rfm_rules.segments: Priority: recent<=30 days & frequency>=5; lapsed>90 days & frequency>=2; other frequency>=5; other frequency>=2; one-time.

quality.missing_customer_id_scope: Overlapping coverage statistic, not an exclusive exclusion reason. Unidentified sales stay in revenue.

findings.title: Merchandise credits need separate monitoring
findings.detail: Credits equal 4.66% of gross merchandise sales. This is a credit-value ratio, not a matched physical-return rate.

findings.title: Repeat purchase among identified buyers
findings.detail: 2,829 of 4,334 identified buyers have at least two positive invoices (65.27%). Anonymous purchases are outside this denominator.

findings.title: Unidentified sales remain in the financial analysis
findings.detail: GBP 1,478,893.6300 in gross merchandise sales lacks a customer ID; it remains in revenue but cannot be assigned to customer segments or cohorts.

findings.title: Peak net-sales month among complete months
findings.detail: 2011-11 records GBP 1,423,188.8000 net merchandise sales. Partial source months are excluded from this comparison.
